failure_modes.mode: Audit probe modifies a live workspace or calls an external service
failure_modes.cause: Production defaults accidentally used by imported pipeline modules
failure_modes.effect: Changed user data or unintended discovery/inference cost
failure_modes.detection: Review diagnostic patches and explicit mocked dependencies
failure_modes.mitigation: Create an isolated temporary workspace before imports, use in-memory databases, and mock all invoked stage/network/AI services.

failure_modes.mode: Guide overstates custom-site or automatic resume capabilities
failure_modes.cause: Confusing allow-list entries with source registration or saved variants with routing
failure_modes.effect: Empty discovery, wrong resume, or erased advanced configuration
failure_modes.detection: Trace registry loading, save behavior, and route fallbacks; reproduce with fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: Document supported operations and source-registration limitations explicitly; provide additive YAML examples and traceable evidence.

failure_modes.mode: Existing runtime defects remain after the audit
failure_modes.cause: Audit scope produces a roadmap rather than applying behavior changes
failure_modes.effect: Streaming hangs, misleading statuses, or unnecessary document generation
failure_modes.detection: Bounded isolated reproductions and anchored findings
failure_modes.mitigation: Track prioritized fixes with acceptance criteria in the audit document.
